Definition: properly, to keep in; hence, to measure; figuratively, to maintain (in various senses)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to seize, contain, measure; 1a)(Qal) to measure, calculate; 1b) (Pilpel) to sustain, maintain, contain; 1b1) to sustain, support, nourish; 1b2) to contain, hold in, restrain; 1b3) to support, endure; 1c) (Polpal) to be supplied; 1d) (Hilpil) to contain, hold, hold in, endure; 1d1) to contain; 1d2) to sustain, endure
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
